unintendedEffects.desc: newPooler._minter (ATokenDispatcherV2) is NEVER set to NFT_MINTER_V2. After replaceDispatcher(4,newPooler), mint(4) routes NFTMinterV2 -> newPooler.dispatch() whose onlyMinter modifier requires msg.sender == _minter (== 0). Every mint(4) reverts. The old pooler has slot1 (_minter) = 0x39Af…2e10f (set by the Story-048 SetMinterOnIndex4Pooler back-fill); the new pooler starts at 0 and the script does not restore it.

skipSimulationMinBPT.evidence: DEFAULT_MIN_BPT=284e18 derived 2026-06-04 for ~527.71 sUSDS; fork at block 25241930 seeded 527.80 sUSDS and pool() minted 287.9 BPT (floor held with ~1.4% margin). --skip-simulation means a live revert (e.g. router query NotStaticCall path, pool drift, or a stale minBPT after material pool movement) would only surface at broadcast time; the script self-guards with require(minBPT>0) and the >=minBPT post-check, but cannot self-detect a stale-too-high minBPT (would revert pool()) — operator must re-query MIN_BPT_WEI before broadcast as the comment instructs.
